主要内容: HENRY SCHEIN INC updated its corporate governance structure on May 31, 2018, following shareholder approval at the Annual Meeting. The changes included aligning special meeting provisions with bylaws, adjusting voting standards to reflect voting power, and moving advance notice requirements to the bylaws. The amendments also reflected new communication technologies and conformed to Delaware law. Additionally, the company adopted Section 141(c)(2) of the Delaware General Corporation Law for board committees, added procedures for shareholder meetings, and permitted electronic communications. HENRY SCHEIN, INC. approved amendments to its Certificate of Incorporation and re-elected BDO USA, LLP as its independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending December 29, 2018. The proposal received 129,258,366 votes in favor, 4,080,116 against, 203,414 abstentions, and 8,964,014 broker non-votes. The 2017 executive compensation plan was also approved by non-binding vote with 126,596,385 votes in favor, 6,433,719 against, 511,792 abstentions, and 8,964,014 broker non-votes.

涉及行业.名称: SECURITY & COMMODITY BROKERS, DEALERS, EXCHANGES & SERVICES
